rows.title: ${title}
rows.body:
# Simple Pancakes

This is a basic recipe that includes all the required ingredients for the perfect breakfast.

## Ingredients
* flour: 2 cups
* eggs: 3 whole
* milk: 1 cup
* sugar: 2 tablespoons
* salt: 1 teaspoon

## Instructions
1. Whisk the eggs and milk together in a large bowl.
2. Add the flour, sugar, and salt.
3. Mix well until smooth and cook on a hot skillet.
